items.q: On which day of a typical 28-day menstrual cycle does ovulation usually occur?
items.qAf: Op watter dag van ’n tipiese 28-dae menstruasiesiklus vind ovulasie gewoonlik plaas?
items.explain: Ovulation occurs around day 14, midway through the cycle.
items.explainAf: Ovulasie vind ongeveer op dag 14 plaas, halfpad deur die siklus.

items.explain: A surge of luteinising hormone (LH) triggers the release of the ovum.
items.explainAf: ’n Skielike toename in luteïniserende hormoon (LH) veroorsaak die vrystelling van die eiersel.

items.q: Progesterone secreted by the corpus luteum mainly maintains:
items.qAf: Progesteroon wat deur die geelliggaam afgeskei word, handhaaf hoofsaaklik:
items.explain: Progesterone keeps the endometrium thick and ready for a possible pregnancy.
items.explainAf: Progesteroon hou die endometrium dik en gereed vir ’n moontlike swangerskap.

items.q: A tubal ligation prevents pregnancy by:
options: Blocking the oviducts so the ovum cannot meet the sperm
optionsAf: Blocking the oviducts so the ovum cannot meet the sperm
items.explain: Cutting or blocking the oviducts stops sperm reaching the ovum.
items.explainAf: Die snyding of blokkering van die eierleiers verhoed dat sperm die eiersel bereik.

items.q: Which contraceptive method also protects against sexually transmitted infections?
items.qAf: Watter anti-konsepsiemetode beskerm ook teen seksueel oordraagbare infeksies?
items.explain: A condom forms a physical barrier, which hormonal methods and sterilisation do not provide.
items.explainAf: ’n Kondoom vorm ’n fisiese versperring, wat hormonale metodes en sterilisasie nie bied nie.

items.q: Hormonal contraceptives mainly prevent pregnancy by:
items.qAf: Hormonale anti-konsepsiemiddels verhoed swangerskap hoofsaaklik deur:
options: Blocking the uterus with a device
optionsAf: Blocking the uterus with a device
items.explain: The hormones suppress FSH and LH so that no ovum is released.
items.explainAf: Die hormone onderdruk FSH en LH sodat geen eiersel vrygestel word nie.
